patterns.note: Scroll-triggered counter animations that dynamically increment from zero to their final metrics as the user scrolls into the statistics section.
An ultra-minimalist, high-whitespace layout that uses generous vertical spacing to create a cinematic, unhurried reading pace.
A sophisticated deep forest green base paired with high-energy mint green and warm yellow accents to signal sustainability and high-tech friendliness.
Clean, border-separated FAQ accordions that expand smoothly to reveal detailed safety and operational information without cluttering the page.

technique_notes: To recreate the scroll-driven counter effect, implement an intersection observer that triggers a numerical interpolation animation (counting up from zero to the target value) once the statistics section enters the viewport.

To build the motion system, use a scroll-linked animation framework where elements fade in and slide upward slightly as the user scrolls, utilizing generous vertical padding to create a breathing, cinematic pacing.

design_tokens.type_scale: High contrast with large, medium-weight headings and small, highly legible body text with generous line-height.

standout: The design stands out through its extreme use of whitespace and cinematic pacing, using scroll-triggered animations to gradually reveal content, which makes the physical robot technology feel clean, futuristic, and non-threatening.
